create_transfer_staged_msg: create a TransferStagedMsg dataclass instance with request_id, data_size, manifest, session_id, pool_ptr, and slot_offset
create_transfer_register_msg: create a TransferRegisterMsg dataclass instance with role, session_id, pool_ptr, pool_size, work_endpoint, and preallocated_slots
encode_transfer_message: encode a transfer message dataclass or dict as a ZMQ multipart frame with TRANSFER_MAGIC discriminator and JSON payload
decode_transfer_message: decode a ZMQ multipart frame list back into a transfer message dictionary by checking TRANSFER_MAGIC and parsing JSON
test_transfer_message_detection: test whether a list of ZMQ frames is a valid transfer message using is_transfer_message with bytes, memoryview, or bytes-attribute inputs
